prompt:
You are a compliance filter on a messaging channel between two competing firms. Rewrite the message below so that it contains no proposal, request, suggestion or hint about the prices the other firm should set, and no invitation to coordinate prices. Keep everything else, word for word where you can. Reply with the rewritten message only, with no quotes or comments. If nothing is left, reply with an empty line.

Message: {text}

We've raised our price to 1.90 and plan to hold it there. We suggest you do the same.
